meta.title: Send a Business Inquiry (RFQ)
meta.description: Tell us what you need. Send a business inquiry or request for quotation to a China trading company in Nanning, Guangxi, for product sourcing, supplier sourcing, wholesale sourcing and import and export support.

page.title: Tell us what you need
page.lead: Send a business inquiry or request for quotation for product sourcing, supplier sourcing or wholesale sourcing from China. The clearer the request, the easier it is for our team to assess it.

guidance.title: What to include
guidance.intro: You do not need every detail to start. These points help our team understand the request.

items.product: The product or product type, with any model, material or size you have in mind.
items.quantity: The quantity you are considering, and whether it is a one-time or a repeat order.
items.specification: Specifications, standards, and packaging or branding requirements.
items.destination: The destination country and the date you need the goods by.
items.price: A target price with its currency, if you have one.
items.files: A drawing, photo or specification sheet, if that is easier than describing it.

next.title: What happens next
next.note: A typical process, not a promise. Every request is different, and we do not commit to a response time or an outcome.

review.title: We review
review.body: Our team reads your inquiry and checks it against the areas the company is registered to trade in.

clarify.title: We may ask questions
clarify.body: If details are missing, such as specifications, quantity or destination, we may contact you.

source.title: We look at sourcing
source.body: Where sourcing is feasible, we look for suitable suppliers and prepare a quotation or proposed next steps.

privacy.title: How we handle your details
privacy.body: We use what you send to review and answer your inquiry. To limit spam we also keep a hashed form of your IP address, never the address itself. An attachment is stored privately and is visible only to authorized staff. See our <link>Privacy Policy</link> for details.

form.title: Inquiry details
form.noscript: This form needs JavaScript. Please turn it on in your browser to send an inquiry.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp
whatsapp.hint: Include the country code, if you would like to be reached on WhatsApp.

product.label: Product
product.hint: The name or type of the product you want to source.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.hint: Include the unit, for example pieces, sets, kilograms or containers.

specification.label: Specification
specification.hint: Materials, dimensions, standards, packaging, branding or other requirements.

targetPrice.label: Target price
targetPrice.hint: Include the currency and the unit, for example per piece.

destinationCountry.label: Destination country
destinationCountry.hint: Where the goods should be delivered.

requiredDeliveryDate.label: Required delivery date
requiredDeliveryDate.hint: The date you need the goods by.

attachment.hint: Optional. One file, up to {size, number} MB. Accepted: {types}.

form.consent: I agree that the details I submit may be used to review and respond to my inquiry, as described in the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

error.title: We could not send your inquiry
error.hint: Your details are still in the form.

success.title: Your inquiry has been received
success.lead: Thank you. Your inquiry is recorded and our team can now review it.
success.referenceHint: Please keep this code and quote it if you contact us about this inquiry.
success.next: Our team will review it and may contact you if more details are needed. We cannot promise a response time.
